Query a 'UCI' engine for the best move

Source: R/uci.R
gm_uci_bestmove.Rd

Optional deeper analysis backend. Requires the processx package and an external 'UCI' engine binary (e.g. 'Stockfish') on the system. Falls back with an informative error when either is unavailable.

Usage

gm_uci_bestmove(
  position,
  engine_path = NULL,
  movetime = 1000L,
  verbose = TRUE,
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

Arguments

position

A gm_position object.

engine_path

Path to a 'UCI' engine binary. If NULL (default), gambitR looks on the PATH for stockfish.

movetime

Search time in milliseconds. Default 1000.

verbose

If TRUE (default), report engine info lines.

call

The execution environment, for error reporting. Experts only.

Value

A tibble::tibble() with columns san, score and pv (principal variation string). One row.

Details

The engine is driven through the standard handshake: uci until uciok, isready until readyok, then position fen ... and go movetime ... until bestmove. Scores are reported from White's perspective, matching gm_evaluate(), and a forced mate is reported as a score of 100000 - plies. The engine process is always shut down, including when the call errors.

See also

Other analysis: gm_bestmove(), gm_evaluate()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # gambitR:::.gm_has_uci()
gm_uci_bestmove(gm_position())
}
